template: claude -p "$(cat {prompt_file})" --output-format stream-json --verbose --model {model} --max-turns {turn_cap} --permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools 'Read,Edit,Write,Glob,Grep,Bash(go build *),Bash(go test *),Bash(go vet *),Bash(go doc *),Bash(go list *),Bash(gofmt *)' --disallowedTools 'Bash(*git *),Bash(*-toolexec*),Bash(*-exec*),Bash(*-vettool*),Bash(*-overlay*),Bash(*pkg/mod*)' --safe-mode --strict-mcp-config --no-session-persistence
